about.description: Single-stock perpetual market on Ondo Perps tracking Yushu Technology Co., Ltd., cash-settled, 24/7, up to 5x leverage, margined in USDC, hourly funding. Users get linear price exposure only - no ownership, dividend or voting rights in the underlying. Adapter snapshot 2026-09-21: mark $73.61, open interest $16.51K, 24h volume $1.98K. Added 2026-09-21 in the third Ondo Perps expansion batch, taking the registry from 45 to 56 RWA markets; the adapter's 65 live rows include 9 crypto perps (BTC, ENA, ETH, HYPE, ONDO, PUMP, SOL, XRP, ZEC) that are out of scope.
